spanish: Y el cerdo, porque partiente pezuña él y hendiente hendidura de pezuña, y él rumia no rumia; impuro él a ustedes.

findings.issue: גֵּרָה is a singular noun (the cud) and יִגָּר is one negated niphal imperfect. The pair rumia/rumia reads as two finite verbs, so an affirmative chew is added and the cud is not kept as the object of a single negated verb.
porque locks כִּי as causal; the token is only a conjunction, so a concessive or completive sense remains open.

notes: Swine, both singular hoof clauses, the 3ms pronouns, impuro, and לָכֶם as ustedes stay inside the tokens.
